name: Bernards Township Summer Recreation Program
description_short: Six week township morning program for children entering kindergarten through grade 5 at three Bernards Township elementary schools (Liberty Corner, Mount Prospect and Oak Street), with arts and crafts, field days, theme days and visiting entertainers.
refund_policy_summary: Full refund less a $20 administrative fee per child if requested in writing before April 24, 2026 at 4:30 pm; no refunds after that or if a child is dismissed.
notes: Non-residents $600 per child for the six weeks, registering from March 23 if space is available; Bernards Township residents $550, registering from February 10. Includes entertainment, special activities and a t-shirt. Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 1:30 pm; no program June 22 and July 3. No supervision before or after program hours. Campers bring a snack and lunch daily. Staff ratio at most 8 to 1.
